say:0:1821606001:1.text: The once-quiet Repair House is now packed with sick stowaways, busier than it ever was before the lockdown.
say:0:1821606001:1.source_cn: 冷静已久的修缮屋里挤满了身体不适的偷渡者，远比戒严前更...

say:1:1821606002:1.text: If Baba Muriel were still here, perhaps they wouldn't feel so helpless...
say:1:1821606002:1.source_cn: 如果穆婆婆还在，也许他们就不会这么无助……

say:2:1821606003:1.text: This isn't the time to dwell on the past. Your magic may be able to help them, and you'd rather not leave their lives entirely in the Syndicate's hands.
say:2:1821606003:1.source_cn: ……现在可不是感慨过去的时间。说不定你的魔法可以解决眼...
